classification: Compare the six frozen new source-native q and q-daylength nominal tagged-animal 95% intervals against the previous archival source-native intervals of exactly the same scientific_name. 'Position conserved' requires all prior supported native q source intervals and the new native q interval exclude zero in the same direction. 'Seasonal slope opposite' requires a supported new source q-daylength interval exclude zero in the sign opposite at least one prior same-species source daylength interval excluding zero. Unavailable/CI crossing zero cannot be assigned a direction. Distinct source DOI is not proven disjoint tagged animal populations.
